GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward Settled Down Two Wide 2nd,m 1 length @ 850m. Just shaded Straightening Up but then peaked Quickly and Gradually Gave Ground . Drifted Well Back in the end # sat 2nd/faded away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be displaying a poor post-race recovery. Trainer was advised that a veterinary clearance would be required before the gelding barrier trials or races again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 6th 6 Lengths 600m 8th 7 Lengths Straightened Up 8th made some ground final 200m # back/ok late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Could not be ridden out to the finish after shifting in away and becoming awkwardly placed outside heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled back 3rd last rails 6 Lengths 600m, popped off fence soon after Straightening Up and had chance, Just could not finish well enough # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Rider reported intention was to settle forward, however was obliged to settle at the rear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward took sit 2nd fence 2 Lengths 600m 2nd fence 2 Lengths home turn 2nd 2 Lengths inside run Straight Kept Going Ok # every ch/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & chased Ok until peaked on run in last 50m. # Even effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After beginning awkwardly was shifted behind runners from a wide barrier. Approaching the 700m was steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 3l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blinkers 1st Time winkers off f/t Jumped Fair Ridden Along early outpaced 1-1 2.5l home turn 2 Lengths Good Run Through 50m Eased of heels but battling at time # every chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 50m was directed inwards to avoid the heels of another runner which shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 3 Lengths off but 4 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn and dropped out # 4 Wide trip
Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off and battled on one pace to the line # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was inclined to lay in under pressure during the straight. App returned to scale at 1.1kg over weight and only claimed 0.5kg of allowance.
